```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
```


```{r load-data}
# Load dataset from notebook 01
drug_data <- readRDS("data/final_dataset.rds")

cat("Dataset loaded successfully\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(drug_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(drug_data), "\n")
cat("Columns available:", paste(names(drug_data), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r experimental-pka, message=TRUE}
pka_results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(drug_data)) {
  drug <- drug_data$Drug[i]
  chembl_id <- drug_data$ChEMBL_ID[i]
  
  tryCatch({
    url <- paste0("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data/activity.json?molecule_chembl_id=",
                  chembl_id, "&standard_type=pKa&limit=100")
    
    req <- httr2::request(url) |> httr2::req_headers(Accept = "application/json")
    response <- httr2::req_perform(req)
    parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr2::resp_body_string(response), flatten = TRUE)
    activities <- parsed$activities
    
    if (is.null(activities) || !is.data.frame(activities) || nrow(activities) == 0) {
      pka_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(pka_results,
        data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                   pKa_exp = NA,
                   N_pka = 0,
                   pKa_values = NA))
    } else {
      filtered <- activities |>
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(standard_value)) |>
        dplyr::mutate(standard_value = as.numeric(standard_value)) |>
        dplyr::filter(standard_value >= 0, standard_value <= 14)
      
      if (nrow(filtered) == 0) {
        pka_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(pka_results,
          data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                     pKa_exp = NA,
                     N_pka = 0,
                     pKa_values = NA))
      } else {
        pka_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(pka_results,
          data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                     pKa_exp = median(filtered$standard_value, na.rm = TRUE),
                     N_pka = nrow(filtered),
                     pKa_values = paste(filtered$standard_value, collapse = ", ")))
      }
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error for", drug, ":", e$message))
    pka_results <<- dplyr::bind_rows(pka_results,
      data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                 pKa_exp = NA,
                 N_pka = 0,
                 pKa_values = NA))
  })
}

# Join with drug_data
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(pka_results, by = "ChEMBL_ID")

cat("pKa SUMMARY\n")
cat("Drugs with experimental pKa:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$pKa_exp)), "\n")
cat("Drugs missing pKa:", sum(is.na(drug_data$pKa_exp)), "\n")
```

```{r experimental-logd, message=TRUE}
logd_results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(drug_data)) {
  drug <- drug_data$Drug[i]
  chembl_id <- drug_data$ChEMBL_ID[i]
  
  tryCatch({
    url <- paste0("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data/activity.json?molecule_chembl_id=",
                  chembl_id, "&standard_type=LogD&limit=100")
    
    req <- httr2::request(url) |> httr2::req_headers(Accept = "application/json")
    response <- httr2::req_perform(req)
    parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr2::resp_body_string(response), flatten = TRUE)
    activities <- parsed$activities
    
    if (is.null(activities) || !is.data.frame(activities) || nrow(activities) == 0) {
      logd_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(logd_results,
        data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                   LogD74_exp = NA,
                   N_logd = 0,
                   LogD_values = NA))
    } else {
      # Filter for pH 7.4 specifically
      filtered <- activities |>
        dplyr::filter(
          !is.na(standard_value),
          stringr::str_detect(tolower(assay_description), "7\\.4|7\\.40|physiolog")
        ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(standard_value = as.numeric(standard_value))
      
      if (nrow(filtered) == 0) {
        logd_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(logd_results,
          data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                     LogD74_exp = NA,
                     N_logd = 0,
                     LogD_values = NA))
      } else {
        logd_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(logd_results,
          data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                     LogD74_exp = median(filtered$standard_value, na.rm = TRUE),
                     N_logd = nrow(filtered),
                     LogD_values = paste(filtered$standard_value, collapse = ", ")))
      }
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error for", drug, ":", e$message))
    logd_results <<- dplyr::bind_rows(logd_results,
      data.frame(ChEMBL_ID = chembl_id,
                 LogD74_exp = NA,
                 N_logd = 0,
                 LogD_values = NA))
  })
}

# Join with drug_data
drug_data <- drug_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(logd_results, by = "ChEMBL_ID")

cat("LogD7.4 SUMMARY\n")
cat("Drugs with experimental LogD7.4:", sum(!is.na(drug_data$LogD74_exp)), "\n")
cat("Drugs missing LogD7.4:", sum(is.na(drug_data$LogD74_exp)), "\n")
```

```{r save-dataset}
saveRDS(drug_data, "data/drug_data_pka_logd.rds")
readr::write_csv(drug_data, "data/drug_data_pka_logd.csv")

cat("Dataset saved\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(drug_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(drug_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(names(drug_data), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```
